note: QSL-2743. Row-contract vectors for FR-830 (selected model-union witness rows). They reuse the declarations of domain-package-acme-shapes.json (Shape Flag(Boolean)/Empty/Both(Pair); List Nil/Cons(Cell); Cell(Integer, List); Nest(Pair, Shape); Holder(pair, shape, pairs)) and the package fixtures/positive-model-tuple-union.json as read by model-tuple-union-vectors.json, and do not restate the declaration semantics (FR-322 'Tuple value types and payload-bearing variant types', FR-440, FR-441). Encodings are the producer sidecar's existing ones, written here as JSON values: `structural_node` and each payload `node` are the serde form of the package's CheckedNodeId, which for the fixture is exactly the `node_id` object of the node in the package (package, path, ordinal); `type_handle`, `settled_key`, `member.declaration`, and the composite and unit `node` of `original_type` are OriginalNodeKey values (the structural-key JSON of the shared node-key codec, nested depth at most 32); `original_type` is a complete OriginalValueType; `original_case` is the DeclarationKey {package, node} of the selected document's variant. The fixture package is symbolic: its node ids are written here and nowhere does a vector derive an original key from a name. For model declarations the original key and the emitted node id are written alike because a producer's original key and settled key coincide for them today; their roles stay distinct and no vector requires the equality. Patches are RFC 6902 over a case's `model_unions`; `document_patch` is RFC 6902 over the `domain_package` of model-tuple-union-vectors.json and `package_patch` over the package fixture. Budget cases state relations to a baseline measured on the same input, not static totals, because the native work and storage policy (FR-830 'Work and storage') fixes each charge. These are published inputs and expected results only; no reader implements FR-830 and nothing here is qualified by running them.

positive.note: Authored order Flag, Empty, Both is carried canonically as Both, Empty, Flag with positions 2, 1, 0; rows sort List before Shape.
Shape reaches Boolean and Pair; Pair reaches Boolean and Integer; List is not reached.
The List row is wrong but is not in the reached closure, so it is neither inspected, charged nor retained; MUW-R-35 refuses the same rows under full scope.
List reaches Cell; Cell reaches Integer and List; the visited List is not expanded again.
Nest is a tuple and needs no row; its Shape position makes Shape reached.

The Holder object type (domain-package-acme-shapes.json) adds a model/object_type node by the same form as Switch in fixtures/positive-state-transition.json, with its generated source-map entry. Its fields pair, shape and pairs reach Pair, Shape and Pair (3 edges); Pair adds 2 and Shape adds 2. The patched package is a published input only and has not been read by any reader.
model-tuple-union-vectors.json TK-08: Shape.Flag's payloadType is Clock. The row keeps the authored payload with no node and no original_type; Empty stays nullary.
List gains a nullary Empty beside Shape.Empty; the two cases are two members with distinct declarations and distinct original cases.

Shape gains Chain(List). The payload's original type is the composite whose key is List's own row's type_handle, so the supplied witness of the payload node names it; Both's composite key names a tuple no row witnesses and is preserved as the producer's claim.
Every join passes with producer keys the reader cannot authenticate: the rows are admitted and the keys returned byte for byte. Admission is not a claim of provenance.
